title: Encoder descriptor parity scaffold
summary: Adds a behavior-identical encoder descriptor scaffold for the existing HEVC/NVENC primary and libx265 CPU fallback paths, with generated context and active backlog docs refreshed.
reason: Encoder breadth and AV1 work needs descriptor-based command generation before new encoder families are enabled. This slice creates the descriptor seam while preserving existing emitted FFmpeg arguments.
behavior_before: New-EncodeVideoFlags built HEVC/NVENC and libx265 argument lists directly in a two-branch function body. Phase 0 snapshots existed as the parity oracle.
behavior_after: Existing HEVC/NVENC and libx265 argument lists are produced through seeded descriptors, while unsupported or not-yet-enabled encoder names still use the legacy branch. Phase 0 snapshots remain unchanged.
manual_validation: pwsh -NoProfile -File ops\pipeline\tests\Legacy\Invoke-LegacyDesktopReliabilityRegressionChecks.ps1 - attempted; failed before encode-policy assertions because deployability checklist path was not found
pwsh -NoProfile -File ops\pipeline\tests\Unit\Invoke-EncodeFlagPolicyChecks.ps1 - passed (22 encode argument snapshots unchanged)
pwsh -NoProfile -File ops\pipeline\tests\Unit\Invoke-MediaRouteSelectionChecks.ps1 - attempted; failed before encode flag coverage on unchanged unknown-height route threshold expectation
rollback_plan: Revert the descriptor module, loader registration, New-EncodeVideoFlags delegation, test dot-source updates, docs, generated summaries, and project index changes. No runtime state or media files are touched.
